note: The main banks were taken as Latvia's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): Swedbank, SEB and Citadele. Swedbank Latvia: its credit card page and comparison, read 2026-10-30. The Swedbank Credit Card (the basic card, kept under its earlier written name) costs 2.50 euros a month, the Gold Credit Card 6 and the Platinum credit card 17. Each card's rate is stated only as 'starting from' 20%, 16% and 14% a year, set individually; the floor is written, the bank naming no higher figure. The currency exchange mark-up is 2%, 0.5% and 0%. Free cash withdrawals up to 750 or 1,000 euros a month are thresholds not modelled and no fee above them was read, so no cash fee is written. The interest-free periods run to the end of the month or the 10th or 20th of the next, not a fixed count of days, and aren't written. SEB's and Citadele's card prices weren't reached in this pass and aren't written. In wave 4 (2026-10-30) Citadele's credit card page (read 2026-10-30) gives its cash allowance and limit but no rate or fee, and SEB's Latvian card page wasn't at the address tried (404); no bank was added.
